tools.name: start_here
tools.description: Free. Call FIRST when the person asks what Ania does, how to start, or seems to think Ania only makes videos or only avatars. tools.name: get_balance

Call before quoting/buying or when the user asks what they have or can spend. To add credits, use top_up.

tools.name: my_avatars
tools.description: Lists the avatars the user created or got on Ania, with thumbnail and status. Use for "my avatars", "the avatar I made", or before opening one of theirs. For the public catalogue use search_avatars or search_marketplace; for purchases use my_purchases.

tools.name: list_styles
tools.description: Visual styles, states/movements (idle, talking, waving…), resolutions and qualities the Ania avatar factory accepts today. Call before quote_avatar and pass the ids exactly as returned; never invent a style.

tools.name: quote_avatar
tools.description: Prices an animated talking avatar before anything is spent: AI cost + Ania fee (+ own-image preparation, if any), returning a quoteId valid for ~10 minutes. Charges nothing. Use after agreeing the description, style and states (from list_styles) with the user. Show the price and wait for the user’s

tools.name: create_avatar

Confirmation: if your app shows Ania’s confirmation form, the user answers there. Otherwise the tool returns the question with the exact amount and a confirmation_id: ask the user in t

tools.name: creation_status
tools.description: Where an avatar creation stands: status, what awaits review and the previews (image and movements) to show the user. Without jobId, lists recent creations ("continue my avatar"). Free. Generation takes minutes: do not poll in a loop; the user gets an email when there is something to review.

tools.name: approve_image
tools.description: Approves the reference image after the user saw it (creation_status) and liked it; Ania then generates the movements. tools.name: approve_movement

tools.name: redo_movement

tools.name: skip_movement

tools.name: resume_avatar
tools.description: Resumes a stopped creation (e.g. after a top-up) when the user asks. Paused: free. tools.name: cancel_avatar
tools.description: Cancels a creation in progress when the user asks. Irreversible. Ania asks the user (confirmation form); without one, the tool returns the question: ask it and call again with user_confirmed: true only after an explicit yes. Never decide for the user.

tools.name: use_my_image
tools.description: FREE: hands Ania a reference image you generated or the user sent, then runs the check (the small prep fee is only charged at creation and is already in quote_avatar with ownImageRef). tools.name: confirm_spend

tools.name: show_my_avatar

tools.name: install_in_project

tools.name: open_in_player

tools.name: publish_to_marketplace

tools.name: download_avatar

tools.name: top_up

tools.name: wake_word_status

tools.name: test_wake_word

tools.name: download_wake_word

tools.name: improve_voice

tools.name: train_voice

tools.name: download_voice

tools.name: search_marketplace
tools.description: Searches the Ania marketplace for avatars and wake words, with a free-only filter and (for wake words) the language they listen in. Returns ids for get_free (free items) and buy_listing (paid). Prices in the user’s currency. For a visual avatar gallery use search_avatars.

tools.name: free_avatars

tools.name: get_free

tools.name: buy_listing

tools.description: Adds the next episode to a project. With `de` (another episode) it continues the series: same scenes, layouts and rhythm, marked as derived; without it, a one-scene starter. Then write it with studio_escrever_roteiro. Free.

tools.name: search_avatars

Call this whenever the user wants to see, browse, list, search or pick an Ania avatar — "show me some Ania avatars", "what avatars do you have", "mostre os avatares da Ania". Never generate an image instead: these are real marketplace listings, and a generated picture

tools.name: get_avatar
tools.description: Get the details of one Ania avatar: preview, seller, size, and whether it is free to install or a paid listing on the Ania site. Renders its own card — do not restate the details in prose.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the Ania marketplace categories. Use the returned slug as the category filter for search_avatars.

tools.name: setup_companion
tools.description: Set up the Ania Avatar companion so the avatar lip-syncs to ChatGPT's voice on this computer. Returns a one-click launch link and, if needed, the right installer.

tools.name: link_player
tools.description: Connect this chat to an Ania Player running on the user’s computer. The user enables Remote Control in the player, which shows a 6-character code.

tools.name: player_status
tools.description: Report what the connected Ania Player is doing: visible or hidden, which avatar is loaded, its audio source and sensitivity.

tools.name: list_actions
tools.description: List the expressions and animations the currently loaded avatar can play, so one can be triggered by name.

tools.name: play_action
tools.description: Play one of the avatar’s expressions, such as a wave. Use list_actions first to see what this avatar can do.

tools.name: set_avatar
tools.description: Switch the connected player to another avatar from the marketplace. Takes a listing id; free listings install automatically, paid ones open on the Ania site.

tools.name: speak
tools.description: Make the avatar say a short line out loud, lip-synced. Up to 500 characters.

tools.name: show_avatar
tools.description: Show the avatar window on the user’s screen.

tools.name: hide_avatar
tools.description: Hide the avatar window. The player defers this while the avatar is speaking, so it can take a moment.

tools.name: set_speed
tools.description: Set the avatar’s idle and talking animation speed. 1 is normal.

tools.name: set_sensitivity
tools.description: Set how loud the captured audio must be before the avatar’s mouth moves, from 0 to 1. Raise it when the mouth never stops.

tools.name: troubleshoot_audio
tools.description: Diagnose why the avatar's mouth is not moving with ChatGPT's voice, and fix the audio source.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "ania" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: use_my_image, top_up, studio_sugerir_imagens · Private data: get_balance, create_avatar, adjust_image, redo_movement, resume_avatar, open_in_player, publish_to_marketplace, download_avatar, record_wake_word, create_wake_word, recording_tips, train_voice, buy_listing, studio_criar_projeto, studio_escrever_roteiro, studio_enviar_midia, studio_listar_midias, studio_sugerir_imagens, studio_renderizar, studio_baixar · Public sink: creation_status, use_my_image, publish_to_marketplace, studio_criar_projeto, studio_pronuncia, studio_enviar_midia, studio_baixar · Destructive: studio_listar_projetos, studio_criar_projeto, studio_escrever_roteiro, studio_listar_layouts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: use_my_image, top_up, studio_sugerir_imagens · Private data: get_balance, create_avatar, adjust_image, redo_movement, resume_avatar, open_in_player, publish_to_marketplace, download_avatar, record_wake_word, create_wake_word, recording_tips, train_voice, buy_listing, studio_criar_projeto, studio_escrever_roteiro, studio_enviar_midia, studio_listar_midias, studio_sugerir_imagens, studio_renderizar, studio_baixar · Public sink: creation_status, use_my_image, publish_to_marketplace, studio_criar_projeto, studio_pronuncia, studio_enviar_midia, studio_baixar · Destructive: studio_listar_projetos, studio_criar_projeto, studio_escrever_roteiro, studio_listar_layouts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
